crossRefs.note: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.
“Remember now, Yahweh, I beg you, how I have walked before you in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that…
Remember me, my God, for good, all that I have done for this people.
I commanded the Levites that they should purify themselves, and that they should come and keep the gates, to sanctify…
Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

translations.web: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your loving kindness.
translations.bsb: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
translations.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O LORD, according to thy lovingkindness.
translations.asv: Consider how I love thy precepts: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according to thy lovingkindness.
